main_idea: On-policy distillation improves GDPval results across two model families.
ideas: Nemotron gains a +20.9% net win-loss margin.
Qwen gains a +21.4% margin and 7.9 rubric points.
On-policy distillation trains students on their own generations.
summary: The extra process diagram and explanatory subtitle clutter otherwise clear cross-family GDPval results; nothing essential is missing.
